decisions.reason: The pipe cleaning box builds on existing fluid-handling fabrication for utilities, so keeping it on the market costs little while its demand is still uncertain after only one year.
Public waste bins are distant from the core offer and carry more uncertainty, but one year of presence reveals too little to justify abandoning an option that opens new public-sector markets cheaply.
The ground sleeve line uses existing steel processing and coating capabilities, so it is a low-cost option worth keeping until results show its value.
Cast iron sleeves overlap with the broader sleeve line and could be merged into it, but the cost of carrying them is minimal and the evidence is still too early to drop them.
Steel ground sleeves fit the firm's core steel expertise and cost little to keep, so the option should stay open while uncertainty about demand resolves.
